entities.name: William Hodges Mann
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Hodges Mann was an American lawyer, Confederate soldier and Democratic politician who became the first judge of Nottoway County, Virginia and the last Confederate veteran to serve as the Governor of Virginia.
